text:
nina: saw 8 CSV-import leads go to overflow during last EMEA ingest even though SDR queues were empty. seems enrichment latency is causing claim expiry.

harry: yep, enrichment calls hit 30-45s for bulk imports. claim_ttl is 20s so fallback happens too quickly.

devon: proposal: add a per-route "import_grace_window" feature that keeps a short pending state (e.g., 40s) where late enrichment can reassign owner. opt-in per route so realtime traffic unaffected.

sam: safety checks: only auto-reassign if enrichment.confidence >= 0.6 AND SF.last_activity < enrichment.timestamp, plus per-rep rate limit (2/hr). log reassign_attempt, reassign_success, reassign_skipped.

routing-bot: webhook: enrichment contact 00b12 returned owners after 37s, event=evt_1122

harry: that would have been captured by the grace window. devon can you draft a small PR and include metrics: deferred_candidates, reassign_rate, overflow_rate_imports?

devon: yep. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lead-routing/pull/912 (WIP). default off. will include rollback toggle.

nina: add runbook steps for support: 1) check routing events for claim_expire 2) check enrichment.source 3) check reassign logs 4) manual reassign via SF if needed.

sam: agree. start with 1% of import traffic for canary and monitor 12h.

nina: thanks team
